statement: For a nontorsion point on a CM elliptic curve with all CM endomorphisms defined, the p-adic joint torsion/Kummer image is open for every p, and the joint image for finitely many distinct coefficient primes is open. After every finite base extension a finite Frobenius condition forces all these primary components of the point to vanish locally. All finite quotient prime divisors lie among primes dividing the products p(p^2-1).
depends_on: CM action on Tate modules; degree-one good Frobenius; elementary central-cocycle identity; Mordell-Weil and Kummer injection; distinct pro-p Sylow decomposition; Chebotarev
answers: A.12 and Lead5: exact Kummer openness and finite-entanglement input for all finite coefficient changes
notes: The proof is direct, including p2 and p3 and cases where E[p] is rational. The translation span is a CM-algebra submodule; a proper component would contradict the Kummer injection via the central-cocycle identity. Joint openness is proved through closed subgroups of products of distinct pro-p groups, not merely inferred from the projections. The zero-primary Frobenius condition is re-chosen after every finite base extension.

statement: For an abelian Selmer exponent equal to one integer outside a finite coefficient-prime set, every global unit character that extends as a unit at that integer point agrees with its rational-point value in all coefficient components outside one explicit finite set.
depends_on: A.61; Kummer and inflation-restriction; elementary cyclotomic central-cocycle identity; exact disjointness of a lambda-power Kummer extension and a division tower with no lambda-order quotient; Chebotarev; all-place Selmerness
answers: A.12 and Lead5: simultaneous coefficient forcing for finite alterations, including compact point equal to a cusp
notes: For each lambda^r the zero-primary neighbourhood is chosen over F=L(mu_lambda^r), so no unjustified entanglement compatibility over L is used. The global lambda-Kummer extension is disjoint from the full joint p-division tower by the explicit finite prime-divisor bound. Restriction to F is injective for lambda unramified in L and odd. No finite support of the original completed Kummer class is assumed.

statement: On every CM elliptic curve punctured at all N-torsion, an abelian Selmer compact exponent which equals one integer at all but finitely many coefficient primes must equal that integer everywhere. The lifting set on all finite alterations of integers is therefore exactly Z, also for the intrinsic metabelian Selmer quotient.
depends_on: A.61-A.62; nonconstant torsion-divisor units, with a ratio regular at O for the zero integer; local multiplicative Kummer kernel; Hindry1988 Theorem1 on E times Gm; Stoll8.2 with real-place erratum; local elliptic logarithm
answers: A.12 and Lead5: complete exclusion of every one-prime or finite-prime coefficient alteration of an integer, uniformly over every cubic elliptic twist; strengthens A.60
notes: For almost all residue primes q, the q-adic forced unit equality makes the unit ratio a root of unity, while the compact difference is finite torsion supported on the altered coefficient primes. The graph in E times Gm has only finitely many torsion points because its nonconstant unit coordinate excludes any positive-dimensional torsion coset. Stoll's finite-support theorem applies to the proper adelic point already in the closure of E(L); local logarithms then recover the exact integer exponent. No finite-Sha theorem over the splitting field is required. This uses the full abelian coefficient module, does not identify a specific congruence cover, and does not settle exponents differing from every integer at infinitely many coefficient primes.
